propositions: A deterministic shadow comparator must consume observed call/result sets from both legacy and RP-06 projections, enforce an allowlist of approved deltas, detect field-level mismatches, and never issue model calls or control final verdict.

Repository-policy guards must fail when review gates bypass CriteriaSnapshot for direct routing reads, when a second discovery scheduler is introduced outside the shared kernel, or when per-unit trace fields enter review/review-status schemas.

A live external provider canary must exercise the default plan-review and code-review paths through real LLM providers, assert narrow final verdicts (PASS/BLOCK), confirm at least one discovery call reaches each provider, and retain reducer-ignored internal traces without printing secrets or prompts.

Documentation must establish final ownership: gate-owned authored topology/strategy, shared snapshot/execution facts, RP-01 owns provider retry, and rollback requires code revert to retained compatibility projection without journal rewrite.

New code must ignore legacy checkpoint envelopes and the retained compatibility projection must not write new envelopes or decide final verdicts, ensuring deterministic behavior across both defaulted gate paths.

The external provider matrix exercise (run 32579533715, 2026-08-22) confirmed real discovery calls on all three provider arms (anthropic: 85 calls, openai: 94 calls, bedrock: 89 calls) with canary passing and narrow verdicts retained.
